einzeiler: Examining the risks of artificial intelligence and potential congressional regulation.
kurzfassung: Evangelists claim AI increases productivity while doomsayers warn of destruction. Lawmakers and businesses are attempting to figure out how to regulate the burgeoning industry. This episode examines the associated risks and potential actions by Congress.
stichpunkte: Differing perspectives on artificial intelligence from evangelists and doomsayers
Efforts by lawmakers and businesses to regulate the industry
Analysis of the risks posed by artificial intelligence
Discussion on what actions Congress can take
beschreibung:
Evangelists say AI saves time and increases productivity. Doomsayers argue AI will destroy humanity. While the truth may be somewhere in between, lawmakers and businesses are figuring out how to put the toothpaste back in the tube & find ways to regulate the burgeoning industry. We take a look at the risks, and what Congress can do.

This episode: senior political correspondent Tamara Keith, congressional reporter Eric McDaniel, and technology correspondent John Ruwitch.

This podcast was produced and edited by Casey Morell and Bria Suggs.

Our executive producer is Muthoni Muturi.
